title: MSI mode bench
intro: Reproduce the measurements behind the RigPolice article https://rigpolice.com/system/articles/enable-msi-mode/ . `msi-bench.ps1` records the interrupt mode of every PCI device, ISR and DPC time per driver from a kernel trace, and a stall probe pinned to one CPU. The Superposition load below is the GPU-bound load for it.
needs: Run one interrupt-mode state per series (stock, then after `msi-mode-utility.ps1`, with a reboot between).
touch: one temporary ETW session named "NT Kernel Logger" that it starts and stops itself, and the stall-probe thread
